text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyoeeeh~?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you sure about this? I seriously 
can't handle horror. Won't I just end up 
hating it even more instead of overcoming 
it?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
N-No... I'll do my best! I don't want the 
two of you's help to go to waste!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You're super fired up! So we're good to 
keep going with special training, right?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! I'll overcome my fears by the Holy 
Hoof Festival and become a splendid guide 
for the Demon King's Castle~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeek!? Right there, right there, right 
theeeere! Didn't something just pass by 
right there!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"In the shelf's shadow! It's lurking in 
the shadows! I-If you get close, it's 
definitely gonna attack~~~!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"She's not here, definitely not! That's 
just Doto's... rich imagination running 
wild, right!?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-I'm so sorrryyy... Ugh, I'm 
totally failing as a guide, aren't I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's not true at all, I think it's the 
opposite! If you understand what it feels 
like to be scared, wouldn't that make you 
great at guiding people who aren't good 
with horror?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Fueh?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally! Isn't she way too OP for even 
being able to comfort the scaredy-cat 
crying girls?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...D-Do you really think soo...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! If we just don't overthink 
it, we can totally just vibe our way 
through, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
First off, let's go with a party-hard, 
hype-up-the-vibes vibe!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eh, ayyy?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaay! Hey mr. zombie over there, you're 
rotting so hard it's peak comedy lmao!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I suck so bad at piano it hurts! Cut this 
sound out for me, pretty please!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Come on! You go blow them away too, Doto♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyoaaah!? ...O-Oh, just the grass 
rustling... G-G-Grass, yay!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa~~~!? Gl-Glass... chan! How are you 
doin'—!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaay♪ Doto! While we're hyped, wanna 
guide people through the haunted house?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Right, aw yeaaah!? I-I'm off! Gonna crush 
it~~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Up ahead is totally full of vibes, 
y'knooow?! B-B-Be suuuper careful, 
totally!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoooo!! That's the spirit, Doto~♪ We're 
getting hyped up too~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Doto-chin, isn't that a werewolf over 
there!? Ahahaha! Those fangs are insane-o☆

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
P-Pien and sad, right!? Brushing teeth 
looks so tough, the vibes are real~~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Puha! That's what you call out? God-tier 
LOL! How hard are you gonna go~~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: E-Ehehehe...! 'Cause I'm just a plant~~~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, it's bright over there! Are we at 
the goal already!? Insane, so insaaane!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, wanna wrap it up with an Aohal 
finish!? How about all three of us cross 
the goal line together!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Ready, and, GOOOOAL♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha! That was the best, wasn't it~♪ 
How was it for you, Doto?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...! It was so much fun! It was so 
lively that I even forgot to be scared...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Doto-chin, you were totally soaring out 
there~☆ Haunted houses are basically a 
breeze for you now, right?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I feel a lot more confident now~. I 
think I can guide everyone through the 
Demon King's Castle without being scared!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The day of the Holy Hoof Festival. 
Hearing that Meisho Doto and the others 
were running a haunted house, I went over 
to check on them."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer...! Look, look, it's a huge hit!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
For now, Trainer, why don't you join in on 
the fun too?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, hearing you say that gives me 
courage!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, welcome, guest~! Welcome to the Demon 
King's Castle of high vibeees~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Guiding them with confidence, Meisho Doto 
led the haunted house to great success!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...! We're just a few customers 
away from hitting 100~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-Alright...! I'll try calling out to 
gather people!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
C-Come visit the haunted house...! It's 
the Demon King's Castle~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
E-Even if you're easily scared, I'll 
support you all the way~~...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calling out to passersby, Meisho Doto 
promoted the event with all her might, 
bringing in more customers!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. Welchome to the Demon King's 
Cashtle. Come on in~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, I really can't say it properly 
after all. It's not like I'm scared or 
anything, though...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, a customer! Right this w-w-way—"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: What do I doooo...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even while stumbling over her words, 
Meisho Doto gave the tour her absolute 
all!
